messages.author: b256a2742aacd200
messages.subject: Nvim-R 0.9.20
parts:
Hello,

This might be the last release of Nvim-R. I have tried to upload it to vim.org, but got the error: "The requested resource does not allow request data with POST requests, or the amount of data provided in the request exceeds the capacity limit." Anyway, for those interested, the file is on Github: https://github.com/jalvesaq/Nvim-R/releases/tag/v0.9.20

For Neovim users, Nvim-R was superseded by https://github.com/R-nvim/R.nvim (it does not work on Vim). For Vim users, Nvim-R can still be used, but will no longer receive new features. See: https://github.com/jalvesaq/Nvim-R/discussions/797

Considering that this group is not being actively used by anybody, I will not use it for announcements on R.nvim. Instead, I recommend the use of a plugin manager to install plugins from Github.

Best regards,

Jakson Aquino
